content.text:
Both permitted tools are hard-blocked. I could not verify a single role, and I'm not going to report unverified ones.

## What happened

**WebSearch — exhausted before I started.** First call returned: `this session has used its web search budget (200 of 200 WebSearch calls)`. Retried twice at different points, same response. This is a session-level budget shared across all the agents you've run today, not a per-agent limit — my slice inherited it already at zero.

**WebFetch — blocked by provenance.** Every call returns `PROVENANCE_REQUIRED: web_fetch can only retrieve URLs that appeared in a user message, a prior web_fetch result, or an approved fetch prompt.` I tested 11 URLs across both shapes — bare domains named literally in my instructions (`ai-jobs.net`, `aijobs.net`, `workatastartup.com`, `mlops.community`) and constructed VC board URLs (`jobs.pointnine.com/jobs`, `jobs.speedinvest.com/jobs`, `jobs.cherry.vc/jobs`, `jobs.balderton.com/jobs`, `jobs.atomico.com/jobs`, `ycombinator.com/jobs/role/ai-engineer`). All rejected identically.

The two failures compound: WebSearch is normally what seeds WebFetch's provenance set. With search at zero, I have no legal way to introduce a URL, so WebFetch can never fire. The toolset is closed.

I did not fall back to curl/python/bash (you forbade it), and did not use the Chrome MCP (outside the ONLY WebSearch/WebFetch constraint — and anything found that way would land as NEEDS_BROWSER regardless).

## Productive vs dead VC boards

I can't answer this, and I want to be explicit rather than let silence imply a finding: **zero boards were reached.** No board is "dead" from this run. Don't record any of section (A) or (B) as swept or exhausted — the slice is untouched, not empty.

## What unblocks it

Cheapest first:

1. **Raise `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_WEB_SEARCHES_PER_SESSION`** (or start a fresh session with headroom). This fixes both tools at once — searches return URLs, which then satisfy WebFetch provenance.
2. **Or paste board URLs into a genuine user turn.** Parent-agent instructions do not appear to count toward provenance; only the real user's message does. If the user pastes 20-30 board URLs directly, WebFetch works on those plus anything they link to, and the sweep can run search-free.

Option 2 is worth knowing about generally — it makes VC-board sweeps cheap on search budget, since one board page yields dozens of in-provenance company links.

## Target list for the next run

So the retry isn't starting cold. These are **unverified URL guesses from pattern knowledge, not verified boards** — treat as a fetch queue, not results.

Likely Getro/Consider-hosted: `jobs.pointnine.com`, `jobs.speedinvest.com`, `jobs.cherry.vc`, `jobs.balderton.com`, `jobs.atomico.com`, `jobs.northzone.com`, `jobs.creandum.com`, `jobs.earlybird.com`, `jobs.hvcapital.com`, `jobs.lakestar.com`, `jobs.visionaries.vc`, `jobs.notion.vc`, `jobs.dawncapital.com`, `jobs.frontline.vc`, `jobs.octopusventures.com`, `jobs.mmc.vc`, `jobs.468cap.com`, `jobs.antler.co`, `jobs.seedcamp.com`, `jobs.localglobe.vc`, `jobs.connectventures.co.uk`, `jobs.hoxtonventures.com`, `jobs.plural.vc`, `jobs.albion.vc`, `jobs.kindredcapital.vc`, `jobs.amadeuscapital.com`.

Different pattern, check separately: `jobs.sequoiacap.com`, `indexventures.com/jobs`, `jobs.accel.com`, `eqtventures.com/jobs`, `project-a.com/en/jobs`, `joinef.com/jobs`, `airstreet.com/jobs`. La Famiglia folded into General Catalyst — use `gc.com` job board instead.

Section (B): `ai-jobs.net`, `aijobs.net`, `mlops.community/jobs`, `huggingface.co/jobs`, `sifted.eu/jobs`, `tech.eu/jobs`, `eu-startups.com/jobs`.

One caution for whoever picks this up: Getro boards are React apps that render listings client-side. Expect a high NEEDS_BROWSER rate on the `jobs.<vc>.*` family even once fetching works — the value is that individual postings link out to underlying Greenhouse/Lever/Recruitee URLs, which do render and are where actual verification should happen.
